name: How much does construction project management typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does construction project management typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of construction project management varies based on the project's size, complexity, duration, and the scope of services required. Some project managers charge a flat fee, while others charge a percentage of the total project cost, typically ranging from 10% to 20%. Hourly rates are also common for smaller or specialized tasks. It's best to get a detailed proposal after an initial consultation to understand the specific costs for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction project management costs vary by project size and complexity. Charges can be a flat fee, a percentage of the total cost (10-20%), or an hourly rate.
